sources.fact: Downloaded daily buckets use UTC regardless of account timezone. ReturnOnlyCompleteData=true guarantees processed requested coverage, so dataThrough is the requested exclusive UTC end, including a valid empty report. Finality remains provisional: conversions and billing can be restated.

v13 account daily report includes its hierarchy IDs, TimePeriod, CurrencyCode, Spend, Impressions, Clicks, ConversionsQualified and Revenue. Exact currency units and fractional conversions become integer millionths; no two-decimal currency assumption.

v13 campaign daily report includes its hierarchy IDs, TimePeriod, CurrencyCode, Spend, Impressions, Clicks, ConversionsQualified and Revenue. Exact currency units and fractional conversions become integer millionths; no two-decimal currency assumption.

v13 adgroup daily report includes its hierarchy IDs, TimePeriod, CurrencyCode, Spend, Impressions, Clicks, ConversionsQualified and Revenue. Exact currency units and fractional conversions become integer millionths; no two-decimal currency assumption.

v13 ad daily report includes its hierarchy IDs, TimePeriod, CurrencyCode, Spend, Impressions, Clicks, ConversionsQualified and Revenue. Exact currency units and fractional conversions become integer millionths; no two-decimal currency assumption.

Scoped ad/keyword EntityIdToParentIdAssociations use separate entity types. EditorialReasons/QueryByIds returns positional nullable collections; correlate AdGroupId and AdOrKeywordId, preserve ReasonCode and Location.
Active means reviewed; Inactive means pending; Disapproved means failed; ActiveLimited is partly reviewed, not a disapproval. B1 returns pending for ActiveLimited, never invents a rejection.

The documented AdType enumeration covers Text, Image, Product, AppInstall, ExpandedText, DynamicSearch, ResponsiveAd and ResponsiveSearch. Search status uses scoped ad groups, these ad types and keywords; other campaign types return not_implemented.
CampaignType defaults to Search. PartialErrors.Index names the requested ID position; failed or unsupported IDs remain unknown while successful Search observations are preserved.
